texts.APP DISCLAIMER\nPrompt Guide / AI Rules:
APP DISCLAIMER
Prompt Guide / AI Rules Modern 2026 Generator is a development and prompt-engineering application for creating, reviewing and structuring prompts, manifests, exports and project-related working contexts. The application can generate helper data, suggestions, ZIP exports and textual instructions, but it does not replace independent professional, legal, security or production review. All generated content must be checked by the user before use, publication or execution. External links, including GitHub and PayPal links, open in the browser. Donations are voluntary, go exclusively to Eric Heidrich / Nrwx, do not unlock additional rights and are not required for using the application.

texts.Prompt Guide Studio reads an existing pr: Prompt Guide Studio reads an existing project, turns the evidence into scoped AI prompts, manifests and export packages, and keeps generated output reviewable before it is applied.
texts.1. Choose the original project folder as: 1. Choose the original project folder as the working tree.
texts.2. Select UI language for the interface: 2. Select UI language for the interface and AI response language for generated answers.
texts.3. Scan project metadata before building: 3. Scan project metadata before building prompts or exports.
texts.4. Use Prompt Builder/Create only after: 4. Use Prompt Builder/Create only after the project evidence is visible.
texts.5. Review Export/Output results before c: 5. Review Export/Output results before copying or running anything.
texts.Prompt Guide Studio is only valuable if: Prompt Guide Studio is only valuable if it reads project evidence before deciding. Blind AI rules are dangerous: keep the original project as evidence, separate build-only automation, and review every generated export before execution.
